goal: Consume the MASTER-DATA-TEMPLATE-READFIRST-PREFLIGHT visual evidence and decide locally whether a narrow customer write-gate may be prepared, whether another cancel-safe template proof is needed, or whether Master Data remains parked behind Foundation gaps.
whyNow: MASTER-DATA-TEMPLATE-READFIRST-PREFLIGHT proved the real Customers, Vendors and Items/Services list/action surfaces with screenshot QA and a Step Timeline, but still did not create records, select templates, test mandatory-field saves or approve setup/process readiness.
expectedOutput: A local decision result JSON that selects exactly one next case.
Classification of customer, vendor and item/service template or write-gate readiness.
Clear no-write boundary for any future template or record action.
stopConditions: Stop if the read-first evidence is missing or contradicts playthru / UNIVERSAARL-DE.
Stop if the decision would approve direct record writes without a separate Smart Decision.
Stop if template behavior is inferred without evidence.
Stop if Foundation gaps are treated as solved by visible fields alone.

nextCaseOptions.when: Use because the broad preflight saw New/Neu action surfaces but did not prove customer-specific dropdown, template, mandatory-field or cancel boundaries.
Use only after the narrower customer dropdown/template/cancel proof isolates descriptive customer fields and parks posting/VAT/payment/template dependencies.
Use only if the preflight showed New/Neu action surfaces but not enough cancel-safe template or mandatory-field detail.
Use if Foundation setup gaps still block even a narrow descriptive master-data write gate.
